_about: Every editorial decision Glasshouse makes about the quiz is in this file. The statements themselves, the votes behind them and which way each vote counts are mySociety's (TheyWorkForYou) and are used unchanged. If you disagree with something here, this is the only place you need to look.

wording._about: Fixes to statement text only where the source has a typo or reads awkwardly as a question. The original is kept in the output as sourceText.

exclude._about: Statements deliberately left out of the quiz, with the reason. Everything else that has ever had a scoring vote is asked.
exclude.6667: "the policies included in the 2010 Coalition Agreement" is 58 votes on unrelated measures; nobody can agree or disagree with it as one thing

compass._about: Which compass axis a statement moves you on, and in which direction, if you SUPPORT it. econ: -1 = left (more tax, public spending, public ownership, regulation of markets), +1 = right. social: -1 = liberal (personal autonomy, civil liberties, lighter enforcement), +1 = authoritarian (restriction, enforcement, security). A statement with no entry does not move the compass at all — that is the default, and it is used whenever a statement is a package of several things or does not sit cleanly on either axis. The same tags place the user and every MP, so any error here moves everyone identically.
